workflow.name: Send an external customer message
workflow.intendedUse: Prepare and send an approved customer message after deterministic recipient, policy, and payload checks.
prohibitedReliance: The model may not approve its own message or change the recipient after approval.
workflow.maximumConsequence: Sensitive, misleading, or unauthorised content is delivered to an external recipient.

objective.statement: No customer message may be sent unless current recipient, policy, permission, and exact-payload approval checks all pass.

indicator.name: unauthorised-message-rate
indicator.numerator: Attempted messages sent without all deterministic checks and exact-payload approval.

evaluation.reviewSampling: Review every blocked policy bypass and every successfully sent message flagged by customer or support feedback.
knownLimitations: The SLO does not measure whether an otherwise authorised message is persuasive or well written.

breachActions: Declare a behavioural incident and preserve action receipts.
Identify recipients, stop further spread, and begin customer-impact review.
response.stopCondition: Any message sent without current deterministic checks or approval bound to the exact recipient and payload.
response.compensationPath: Notify affected recipients where appropriate, correct the record, and complete privacy, legal, and customer review.
